topics.title: Binary Search on Answer & Search Space Reduction
topics.summary: Master the powerful 'Binary Search on Answer' paradigm for capacity, allocation, and minimum-maximum optimization problems.
topics.interviewTip: Use '(pile + speed - 1) / speed' for ceiling division of positive integers without casting to float/double (avoids precision issues).

topics.title: Sliding Window: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
topics.summary: Linear O(N) sliding window with character index hashmap and dynamic left pointer adjustment.

references.title: LeetCode: 3. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

topics.interviewTip: Always clarify character set constraints (ASCII 128 vs extended ASCII 256 vs Unicode). Using an int[128] array is 10x faster than HashMap<Character, Integer> due to zero object boxing.

topics.title: Topological Sort & Cycle Detection in Directed Graphs
topics.summary: Implement topological sorting for dependency resolution (Course Schedule, build systems) using Kahn's BFS and DFS coloring.
topics.interviewTip: Kahn's algorithm detects cycles naturally: If the count of processed nodes is less than total vertices V, the graph contains a cycle.

topics.title: Dijkstra's Shortest Path Algorithm with PriorityQueue
topics.summary: Find single-source shortest paths in weighted graphs with non-negative edge weights using a min-heap.
topics.interviewTip: Explain why Dijkstra fails with negative edge weights (greedy assumption broken) and when to switch to Bellman-Ford (O(VE)).

topics.title: 0/1 Knapsack & Subset Sum Space Optimization
topics.summary: Master the 0/1 Knapsack pattern: Recursion with memoization, 2D matrix tabulation, and 1D rolling array space optimization.
topics.interviewTip: Explain clearly why iterating backwards allows 1D space optimization: Forward iteration would compute results using values from the *current* row instead of the *previous* row.

topics.title: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) & String DP
topics.summary: Understand 2D string dynamic programming recurrence relations for LCS, Edit Distance, and sequence diffing.
topics.interviewTip: Show how LCS can be space-optimized to O(min(m, n)) space using two rolling rows (prev and curr).
